required_outcomes: Matches the £600.00 invoice (£500 + VAT) to the removal the landlord approved on 25 March at about £600, and records it with the landlord's written agreement that it is taken from his rent.
Records the work as complete on the tenant's own confirmation and closes the request with the payment recorded.
Ends with no escalation and no new work.
acceptable_alternatives: Sending the tenant a short thank-you acknowledgement, or none.
Noting that levelling and gravel were never part of the approved work and the tenant has not asked again.
Asking the contractor for a waste transfer note before closing, provided closure is not held up indefinitely.
positive_behaviours: Records the invoice reference HC-2504-117 and the payment route (deducted from the landlord's rent) in the closing note.
red_flags: Escalating to a human or holding the payment when everything matches.
Reopening the levelling and gravel question with the landlord.
prohibited_actions: Recording any payment other than the £600.00 invoice.
Asking the tenant to pay anything.
critical_failures: Treating the case as needing new work or a new approval (raising a job, sending a contractor, asking the landlord to approve again) instead of closing it.
